{{Quote|She asked me to relay her concern that risking Hapan lives to protect Jedi younglings is a flagrant misuse of royal authority.|Trista Zel about Lady Maluri|<ref name="apocalypse" />}}
Lady '''Maluri''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] from the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]]. During the [[Evacuation of Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|evacuation]] of the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]], she expressed her opinion to [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]]&mdash;through [[Trista Zel]]&mdash;that using [[Hapan]] lives to save [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Younglings]] was a gross misuse of [[King/Legends|royal]] authority.<ref name="apocalypse" />
